hypothesis_zh: 模型只生成无机制的水面材质供体，程序仅投影其中高频残差，可以在不移动连续波场的前提下减少程序塑料感。
single_variable_zh: 与纯程序底图相比只增加模型材质残差；程序高度、振源身份、画框和教学结构不交给模型重画。

prompt_parts.scene_identity: Top-down macro photograph of a shallow laboratory water surface, locked camera, empty tank
prompt_parts.material_goal: transparent blue water, fine natural micro-ripples, subtle caustics, soft specular reflections
prompt_parts.state_delta: uniform quiet material texture without organized circular waves
prompt_parts.must_preserve: even texture scale, stable lighting, no objects, no shoreline, no text

negative_artifacts: large concentric rings, point sources, emitters, interference diagram, text, labels, arrows, user interface, watermark, shoreline, boats, animals, giant waves, frozen plastic, metallic grooves, hard neon outlines, perspective view, cropped tank, blur
